name: laya-delegate
label: needs-reading

text_blocks.text: When RTK asks you to hand an investigation to the Explore sub-agent, call it on the haiku model (Agent tool: subagent_type "Explore", model "haiku") with one precise question built from the task, ask it for file paths, line numbers and the exact lines you will need, and work from its report instead of repeating its searches.

Do not run this search or open these files yourself: hand the investigation to the Explore sub-agent (Agent tool: subagent_type "Explore", model "haiku") with one precise question, and ask it for file paths, line numbers and the exact lines you will need. Then work from its report.

Do not run this search or open these files yourself: hand the investigation to the Explore sub-agent (Agent tool: subagent_type "Explore", model "haiku") with one precise question, and ask it for file paths, line numbers and the exact lines you will need. Then work from its report.

You read a file for a coding agent that will NOT see it, only your reply. First answer what the agent needs for its current step, in a few terse lines, with exact identifiers. Then map the file: one line on what it is; every class, function and method with its exact signature, in file order. Then quote verbatim, grouped under the name of the function that contains them, the lines whose exact text the agent would most need for its step (non-obvious arithmetic, constants, conditions, error handling, config values). Never give line numbers. Never paraphrase code you quote. No advice, no headings. End with exactly: (Exact text: grep -n a quoted line, then Read that file with offset and limit, at most 350 lines.)
How much of this file's exact text does the agent need for its next step?

none: a short summary is enough
a few exact lines
most of the file verbatim
What kind of work is this coding task?

bug: find and fix a bug by reading source code closely
setup: understand or repair a build, configuration, dependency or environment
write: write new code, a script or a port
data: analyse data or files and report results
